I was backing out of a parking space at a grocery store lot in Pasadena, Texas, moving slowly with my brake lights
on, when the rear of my car was struck by another vehicle that had come up the lane faster than I expected. I stopped
right away, checked on the other driver, and waited for the store's staff and the police officer who came to the scene. I

representative, and to the adjuster who called me. I am the named driver on this policy and I was the one operating

been seeing a doctor for a strain. I am submitting this statement so the claim can be processed and my medical costs
